clue.text: Minimal salary increase in, for example, good job!

parts.note: a penny, P, is the least pay imaginable
a raise is a pay increase

explanation.surface: A boss rewards good work with a tiny pay rise and a pat on the back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Minimal salary increase' reads as one phrase, but it splits: the smallest salary is a penny (P), then a raise.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'good job!' is an example of commendation, words of approval for someone's work.

clue.text: Maintain quiet and restrained manner

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet
reserve is a restrained, aloof manner

explanation.surface: Advice to keep calm and composed.
explanation.definitionFit: To maintain something is to keep it intact, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Admitted, audibly? Just so

indicators.note: the setter claims the previous word is just so when spoken, pointing to how it sounds rather than how it is spelt

parts.note: admitted in the sense of permitted

explanation.surface: Someone confesses openly and agrees that is exactly how it was.
explanation.walkthrough: A word meaning admitted or permitted, said out, is identical in sound to the answer, which is itself what 'audibly' means.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done audibly is spoken out so that it can be heard, the adverb's plain meaning.

clue.text: Spell another word for sentence

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a continuous period of time
second meaning: slang for a prison term

explanation.surface: A grammar teacher asks for a synonym of a sentence.
explanation.walkthrough: Spell and sentence look like word-and-grammar talk, but they mean a period and a jail term.
explanation.definitionFit: A stretch is both an unbroken period of time and informal for a term served in prison.

clue.text: Diverted in midstream, use discretion

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

parts.note: the letters run across the end of the first word into the next two

explanation.surface: Advice to a boatman steering a course mid-river.
explanation.walkthrough: Diverted looks like a change of course on the river, but it means entertained.
explanation.definitionFit: Diverted in the sense of entertained: to be amused is to have been entertained.

clue.text: He wrote sacred verses in dull fashion

parts.note: a matt finish is dull, not shiny
to hew is to shape or fashion, as with an axe

explanation.surface: A dismissive review of a hymn writer's tedious style.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In dull fashion' reads as a manner adverbial, but it is two separate words, dull and fashion as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: The author of the first Gospel wrote scripture, whose text is divided into verses.

clue.text: Husband in rebuilt home with kids, in part of Arabia

indicators.note: in places one element inside the other
something rebuilt is put together in a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
H is the standard abbreviation for husband

explanation.surface: A family man lives in a renovated house with his children somewhere in the Gulf.
explanation.walkthrough: Shuffle home and kids, then place the husband's H inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A territory ruled by a sheikh is a political unit found on the Arabian peninsula.

clue.text: Idea I dropped on Tory minister

indicators.note: dropped means the named letter I is let fall out of the preceding word

parts.note: taken as written
Con is short for Conservative, the Tory party

explanation.surface: A policy proposal abandoned by a Conservative government minister.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' just places one piece before the other in a down clue. The minister is a church one, not a government one.
explanation.definitionFit: A deacon is an ordained minister in many Christian churches, ranking below a priest.

clue.text: Revolutionary comrade with little time for non-Communist

indicators.note: revolutionary suggests overturning, so the letters are turned into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
T is the short form of time

explanation.surface: A radical comrade who has no patience for anyone outside the Party.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface paints a Communist; the answer is a believer in democracy, set against one.
explanation.definitionFit: A democrat favours elected government, the opposite camp from one-party Communism.

clue.text: Watch someone like me crossing river as leader, in a fashion

indicators.note: crossing means straddling, so one piece is spread across the other

parts.note: to tend is to watch over
R is the standard abbreviation for river
the crossword setter refers to themself

explanation.surface: The setter watches themself lead the way across a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Someone like me' is the setter talking about themself, a common crossword device.
explanation.definitionFit: One who leads in fashion starts the vogue that others follow; 'in a fashion' doubles as a pun.

clue.text: Reinforcing piece added to shoe to walk backwards

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: backwards says the word for walk is read from its end to its start

parts.note: to pace is to walk

explanation.surface: A shoe gets strengthened so that its wearer can walk backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The reinforced cap over the front of a boot protects the wearer's toes; it is the piece described.

clue.text: Leading characters in final episode ultimately died in conflict

indicators.note: leading characters are the ones at the front of each word

parts.note: the opening letters of the four words

explanation.surface: The main characters in a series finale end up killed in a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leading characters' reads as stars of a TV drama, but it is the first letters of the next words.
explanation.definitionFit: A feud is a long-running bitter quarrel, a kind of conflict.

clue.text: How to connect painter with craft, say, and establish union

definitions.text: How to connect painter with craft, say
definitions.meaning: first meaning: a painter is also a mooring rope, fastened to a boat with a hitch

explanation.surface: An artist teams up with a craftsman to form a partnership.
explanation.walkthrough: A painter is the rope at a small boat's bow, and the craft is the boat, not a skill.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for marrying literally describes fastening a rope securely, which is how a mooring line is attached to a boat.

clue.text: Remaining fish on slate, perhaps, put in the shade

parts.note: left over means remaining
the shad is a fish of the herring family
a drink 'on the slate' is put on credit, so it is owed

explanation.surface: Leftover fish served on a slate board ends up in the shadows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the slate' is British for on credit, a debt chalked up at a pub or shop.
explanation.definitionFit: To put in the shade is to outshine or eclipse, which is what the answer means.

clue.text: President's first lady left in sleeping-place

indicators.note: in places those pieces inside the place to sleep

parts.note: a roost is where birds sleep
Eve was the first woman in Genesis
L is the standard abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: The First Lady of the United States departs from the presidential bedroom.
explanation.walkthrough: First lady suggests a president's wife, but it is Eve, the first woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Two US presidents, Theodore and Franklin D., carried this surname.

clue.text: Close friendship unusually found in main city

indicators.note: unusually means not in the normal way, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A rare example of real companionship discovered in a big city.
explanation.definitionFit: Intimacy is a close personal relationship or familiarity, matching a close friendship.

clue.text: Numbers with other books showing modest talent in novel form

indicators.note: novel form means a new shape, so the letters are set out afresh

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A writer with limited ability turns out some figures and books in the shape of a novel.
explanation.walkthrough: Numbers is the Bible book, not figures; it sits among the other books of the Hebrew scriptures.
explanation.definitionFit: The Book of Numbers is one of the books making up the first part of the Christian Bible.

clue.text: Monster devouring old soldier on horse

indicators.note: devouring means swallowing, so the monster's word takes another inside it

parts.note: a dragon is a mythical monster
O is the standard abbreviation for old

explanation.surface: A beast eats an elderly cavalryman.
explanation.definitionFit: A dragoon was a mounted infantryman, a soldier who rode a horse.

clue.text: Wanting to save money, your old clothes split

indicators.note: clothes as a verb means dresses or covers, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: thy is the old form of your
a rift is a split

explanation.surface: Someone reluctant to spend keeps wearing torn old clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: Clothes looks like a noun for garments but is a verb meaning covers.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrifty person is careful with money, keen to economise and save.

clue.text: Start back and wind up again like this?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to flinch or spring back in alarm
second meaning, read as RE- plus a verb: to wind something round once more

explanation.surface: Instructions for rewinding a spring or hose after starting over.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the split reading: again (RE) plus wind up (a verb for twisting into loops).
explanation.definitionFit: To flinch backwards in shock is to start back; the same word split in two means wind into loops once more.

clue.text: Supporter's complaint about new player

indicators.note: about means around, so the complaint surrounds the new

parts.note: a beef is a grievance or complaint
N is the standard abbreviation for new
a player on stage is an actor

explanation.surface: A football fan grumbles about a newly signed player.
explanation.walkthrough: Supporter suggests a fan, but it means a patron who gives money.
explanation.definitionFit: A benefactor gives money or help to a cause, making them a financial backer.

clue.text: Empty vehicle one gets into

indicators.note: gets into means enters, so the one sits inside the vehicle

parts.note: a van is a vehicle
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone climbs into an unoccupied car.
explanation.walkthrough: Empty looks like it describes the vehicle, but it is the definition, meaning futile.
explanation.definitionFit: Empty in the sense of hollow or futile: a vain effort is a pointless one.

clue.text: Run into small vessel extremely popular with surfers?

indicators.note: into places the first piece inside the second

parts.note: a vial is a small bottle
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A surfboarder paddles into a small boat on a popular beach.
explanation.walkthrough: Surfers are web surfers, not wave riders, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Content that spreads rapidly online, shared by many internet users, is said to have gone viral.

clue.text: In addition, having acted as guide inside Spanish city

indicators.note: inside places the guiding word within the in-addition word

parts.note: too means also, in addition
someone who guided has led

explanation.surface: A tour guide also shows visitors around a city in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Toledo is a historic city in central Spain, famous for its sword-making.

clue.text: Make change in layout concerning pro wrestling location

parts.note: re means regarding or concerning
being pro something is being for it
wrestlers fight on a mat

explanation.surface: Rearranging the venue for a professional wrestling bout.
explanation.walkthrough: Pro reads as professional but means in favour of.
explanation.definitionFit: To reformat a document or disk is to change its arrangement or layout.

clue.text: Hidden in hotel at entrance, as yet undiscovered

indicators.note: hidden in says the letters are concealed within the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run from the end of the first word across the next two

explanation.surface: Something lies concealed in a hotel lobby, still not found.
explanation.walkthrough: Hidden looks like the definition, but it is the indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: Something latent exists but is not yet apparent or developed, so it is still unrevealed.

clue.text: Next to piano, song is secondary activity

parts.note: by means beside
p is the musical marking for piano
a lay is a ballad or song

explanation.surface: A musician beside the piano says singing is a sideline.
explanation.definitionFit: Byplay is subsidiary action going on alongside the main action, especially on stage.
